plugin.note: Use a mirror shield or V's shield for every Basilisk variant. Melee is fastest for Basilisk Knights; ranged crossbows are preferred for safespotting. Ordinary Basilisks are usually skipped, while Knights are killed for the on-task Basilisk jaw rate.

requirements: Mirror shield or V's shield for all Basilisk variants
Basilocked unlock for Konar, Nieve, and Duradel assignments
The Fremennik Exiles for Basilisk Knight access
Bigger and Badder for Monstrous basilisk and Basilisk Sentinel superior spawns
mechanics: Without a mirror shield or V's shield, basilisk gaze deals immense damage and massively drains player stats.
Ordinary basilisks use an extremely inaccurate melee attack with a max hit of 5.
Basilisk Knights use melee and magic, both with a max hit of 20.
Basilisk Knights match the player's attack speed with a maximum frequency of four ticks.
At distance, Basilisk Knights use magic while attempting to move into melee range.
Protection prayers can block either Basilisk Knight melee or magic attacks, but not both at once.
Basilisk Sentinel can launch a slow projectile that stones the player if not dodged.
Cannons cannot be placed anywhere with any kind of basilisk.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Always wear a mirror shield or V's shield, then choose ordinary basilisks for simple task progress or Basilisk Knights for jaw profit after The Fremennik Exiles.
recommendedFor: choosing between ordinary basilisks and Basilisk Knights
requiredOrKeyItems: High alchemy runes for Basilisk Knight alchables
steps: Equip a mirror shield or V's shield before fighting any basilisk.
Use ordinary basilisks in Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or Jormungand's Prison for simple task progress.
After The Fremennik Exiles, use Basilisk Knights when pursuing Basilisk jaw or Neitiznot faceguard progression.
Do not bring a cannon because cannons cannot be placed at any basilisk location.
risks: Removing the shield exposes the player to basilisk gaze damage and stat drain.
Basilisk Knight tasks are slow due to high Defence.
notes: Ordinary basilisks are generally a skip due to their thin drop table and high Defence.
Basilisk Knights become worthwhile mainly for Basilisk jaw.

methods.label: Ordinary basilisks
methods.summary: Kill ordinary basilisks with melee while wearing a mirror shield or V's shield.
steps: Use Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or Jormungand's Prison.
Keep a mirror shield or V's shield equipped.
Use melee and expect low incoming damage from inaccurate melee attacks.
Use safespots if desired.
notes: Ordinary basilisks have a max hit of 5.
They are usually worthwhile to skip, but their low weighting does not make them worth blocking.

methods.label: Basilisk Knights
methods.summary: Kill Basilisk Knights in Jormungand's Prison after The Fremennik Exiles for the improved on-task Basilisk jaw rate.
recommendedFor: players accepting slow kills for profit
prayers: Protect from Melee in melee range
steps: Complete The Fremennik Exiles to access Basilisk Knights.
Equip a mirror shield or V's shield before entering combat.
Use melee for the fastest kills when tanking both attack styles.
Use Protect from Magic when attacking from distance because Knights exclusively use magic while moving into melee range.
Switch protection as needed if allowing melee range, remembering only one attack style can be blocked at once.
Pick up alchable equipment, catalytic runes, herbs, and Basilisk jaw if it drops.
risks: Basilisk Knights can hit up to 20 with melee and magic.
Maximum kill rates are slow, around 100 kills per hour.
notes: Basilisk jaw is 1/5000 off task and 1/1000 on task.
Basilisk jaw combines with Helm of neitiznot to make the Neitiznot faceguard.

methods.label: Ranged safespot
methods.summary: Use ranged weapons from safespots to prevent Basilisk Knight melee attacks while accepting magic retaliation.
steps: Stand behind a Basilisk Knight safespot in Jormungand's Prison.
Keep a mirror shield or V's shield equipped.
Use a crossbow and Protect from Magic.
Expect the Knight to retaliate with magic even while melee is blocked by the safespot.
notes: Safespots prevent Basilisk Knight melee attacks but do not stop magic retaliation.

methods.label: Basilisk Sentinel
methods.summary: Treat Basilisk Sentinel as a dangerous superior spawned from Basilisk Knights after Bigger and Badder.
steps: Keep the shield equipped when the superior spawns.
Watch for the slow-moving projectile special attack.
Move one tile to avoid the projectile.
If encased in stone, click rapidly to escape before taking massive damage.
notes: The Basilisk Sentinel is the superior variant from Basilisk Knights.
Failing the stone special requires the player to click rapidly to escape.

methods.label: Skip or toggle
methods.summary: Use task management because ordinary basilisks are weak rewards and Basilisk Knights are mainly useful until Basilisk jaw is obtained.
steps: Skip ordinary basilisk tasks if not interested in low-reward kills.
Leave Basilocked on while hunting Basilisk jaw from Knights.
After receiving the jaw, consider toggling Basilocked off.
notes: The task page says ordinary basilisks are worthwhile to skip but not worth blocking.
After receiving the jaw, use toggle off for Basilocked if no longer hunting Knights; activating it again costs Slayer points.

methods.label: The Jormungand quest fight
methods.summary: The Jormungand is recorded as source metadata only because it is fought during The Fremennik Exiles and can only be fought once.
recommendedFor: LLM interpretation of the wiki variant table
steps: Treat The Jormungand as a one-time quest fight, not a repeatable task target.
Use the Basilisks task data to understand why it is not a normal runtime task variant.
notes: The Jormungand is listed in the wiki variant table with 600 Slayer XP, but can only be fought once.
